headline: 3 detained in East London during tension over Hasnat Abdullah's event
summary: Tensions flared in East London during a visit by NCP leader and MP Hasnat Abdullah, leading to police intervention and arrests.
details: Tensions erupted in East London during a visit by NCP leader and Member of Parliament Hasnat Abdullah.
The situation escalated into a volatile atmosphere, resulting in the detention of three individuals by local authorities.
The event was intended to be a gathering centered around Hasnat Abdullah's visit, but it was marred by unrest.
Local police intervened to restore order and manage the crowd as the situation became tense.

headline: Economist Prof Abul Barkat gets bail in murder case
summary: A Dhaka court has granted bail to the former Janata Bank chairman in the connection with the death of businessman Abdul Wadud during the July Uprising.
details: A Dhaka court has granted bail to economist Prof Abul Barkat in the murder case of businessman Abdul Wadud, who was killed at Dhaka’s Nilkhet during the July Uprising.
Dhaka Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Mohammad Mostafizur Rahman ordered his bail on a bond of Tk 5,000 after a hearing on Tuesday.
Barkat's legal counsel argued for bail on health grounds, while the prosecutor opposed the application.
The economist was shown arrested in the Wadud murder case on Sunday, after which his lawyer filed for bail.
Barkat had previously been arrested on July 10 last year in a case involving the alleged embezzlement of Tk 2.97 billion from Janata Bank.
While he received bail in the Anti-Corruption Commission case on June 7, he remained in jail as the Detective Branch applied to show him arrested in the murder case.
Businessman Abdul Wadud was shot dead in Nilkhet on July 19, 2024, and the case filed by his brother-in-law names ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina and 130 others as accused.
caption:
Prof Abul Barkat has been granted bail in a murder case linked to the July Uprising.

A Dhaka court has granted bail to economist Prof Abul Barkat in the murder case of businessman Abdul Wadud, who was killed at Dhaka’s Nilkhet during the July Uprising.

Dhaka Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Mohammad Mostafizur Rahman ordered his bail on a bond of Tk 5,000 after a hearing on Tuesday.

Barkat's legal counsel argued for bail on health grounds, while the prosecutor opposed the application.

The economist was shown arrested in the Wadud murder case on Sunday, after which his lawyer filed for bail.

Barkat had previously been arrested on July 10 last year in a case involving the alleged embezzlement of Tk 2.97 billion from Janata Bank.

While he received bail in the Anti-Corruption Commission case on June 7, he remained in jail as the Detective Branch applied to show him arrested in the murder case.

Businessman Abdul Wadud was shot dead in Nilkhet on July 19, 2024, and the case filed by his brother-in-law names ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina and 130 others as accused.
